canonical_question: How is the partial PDF g_ab(r) calculated when dealing with a multicomponent system with many possible atomic pair types?

question_variants.question: How is the partial PDF g_ab(r) calculated when dealing with a multicomponent system with many possible atomic pair types?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The document mentions that partial PDF was calculated and provides the formula used for this calculation in the simulation steps, but does not detail how the summation handles specific multicomponent pair types explicitly beyond the general formula.

answers.answer: The partial PDF is calculated using the formula: g_ab(r) = (V / (N_a N_b)) * < Σ δ(|r_ij| - r) >, where the summation averages over atomic configurations in the canonical ensemble.
answers.conditions: 1600 °C, Canonical ensemble (NVT), VASP, PAW, PBE, 350 eV cutoff
answers.measurement_outcome: Partial PDF calculated from atomic configurations
answers.mechanism: Calculation of atomic pair distribution from simulation snapshots
answers.boundary_limitation: None specified for the formula itself in the text
evidence_spans: The atomic structure in the liquid state can reveal the useful information about the preferred interatomic bonding that may impact the formation of the disordered solid solution during solidification [18] , [64] .
The liquid densities were determined by adjusting the cell volume so that the average pressure vanished in equilibrium at T = 1600 °C, yielding an atomic volume of 12.72 Å 3 /atom.
